payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Diagnose the real-Obsidian modal-open lifecycle before rerunning write acceptance. Two clean-source athena runs (monitors gej22x5f1vmv and njeah1bw9463) built bob-cli SHA 7703011d6df8bfd0a6a40683d1ec61a774350979, passed prerequisites, and failed identically before assertions: openPropertyEditor returned ok, but the .bob-property-editor DOM probe remained false until timeout. Both reports have zero assertions and screenshots, and no console exceptions; the offline self-test passes. A prior manual launch with the same plugin and fixture opened successfully, so no write-path defect is confirmed. Keep this phase in progress; add modal-open diagnostics or resolve the startup race, then rerun acceptance.

Continued the landed harness instead of rewriting it. Short real-Obsidian diagnostics on athena reproduced a connected modal containing editor HTML while the global document selector returned zero; later fresh-profile probes found it normally, so the startup cause remains unconfirmed. Added harness startup readiness, bounded modal lifecycle/error traces, owner-document and modal HTML diagnostics, failure PNG capture, and complete Bob invocation logs. Tightened null/empty assertions to compare value cells and press unchanged Enter with exact disk-byte checks; replaced screenshot-size gating with recorded visible-editor and PNG-dimension assertions. Four harness tests pass; npm run build and npm run validate pass; bob plugins sync reports all ledger-tools files unchanged. No epic-symbol entries remain. Full plugin tests and a fresh clean-CLI athena run are being handed to a monitor; local results will be under .git/property-editor-acceptance-results, including summary.json, property-editor-report.json, shots, npm-test.log, and athena.log. Remaining work: use that evidence to fix any real failure, obtain green write acceptance, register report/screenshots, then close only this phase.

Diagnosed startup from failureDiagnostics and inspected the failure PNG. A fresh-profile Athena probe reproduced document.hasFocus=false and Obsidian activeWindow/activeDocument pointing at about:blank; native Modal.open() explicitly appends to activeWindow.document.body. Page.bringToFront plus window.focus restored activeWindow to the real app window; a second fresh-profile probe then mounted the editor into app://obsidian.md/index.html. Added this focus step and readiness predicate to the harness, plus active-window diagnostics and a regression test that rejects both stale activeWindow and unfocused documents. All 5 harness tests pass, build:check and diff checks pass. Prior full suite had 9013 pass, 5 skipped, and only the known timing failures bob-cli-km and bob-cli-io; both affected suites pass in isolation (40/40), with all 26 serialized perf tests already green. No epic symbols remain. Failed-run files are preserved under .git/property-editor-acceptance-failed-startup; the next monitored clean-source acceptance run will replace .git/property-editor-acceptance-results. This corrects the harness startup failure; full write acceptance is still required before closing.
